Reduced cognition, increased blood pressure, and renal dysfunction in adults are also possible; classified as probably carcinogenic to humans", "Applying the Guideline and Comments": "MAC is for total lead. Lead levels should be kept as low as reasonably achievable. Sampling should be done at the tap to reflect average exposure. The best approach to minimize exposure to lead from drinking water is to remove the full lead service line. Drinking water treatment devices are also an effective option."}
